subtitle: Sigmoid Probabilities & Binary Cross-Entropy
summary: Classify binary outcomes using the sigmoid function, linear decision boundary, and ROC-AUC.

evaluationChart.title: ROC Curve & AUC Score
evaluationChart.description: Plots True Positive Rate against False Positive Rate across all probability thresholds.

advantages: Outputs well-calibrated class probabilities rather than just hard labels.
Fast, convex optimization with low risk of overfitting on linearly separable data.
Log-odds coefficients provide clear feature importance and directionality.
limitations: Restricted to a linear decision boundary unless features are engineered.
Struggles with complex XOR or concentric non-linear class geometries.
Sensitive to severe class imbalance without threshold tuning.

codeTemplates.scikitLearn:
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import numpy as np

X = np.array([[1.2,1.5],[2.3,1.9],[3.5,2.2],[5.6,5.9],[6.9,5.5],[8.1,6.8]])
y = np.array([0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1])

clf = LogisticRegression().fit(X, y)
probs = clf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
print('ROC-AUC:', roc_auc_score(y, probs))
